msg: rule sheet for pydantic 1→2 from cache (348 rules)

diagnosis: The upgrade to Pydantic v2 breaks the project due to multiple API changes. The immediate collection error is caused by the special `__root__` field in `KubeSecurityContent`, which is no longer supported and must be replaced with `RootModel` or a standard field plus `@root_validator`. Additionally, several method names have changed (`dict`→`model_dump`, `parse_obj`→`model_validate`, `update_forward_refs`→`model_rebuild`), config keys renamed (`allow_population_by_field_name`→`populate_by_name`), exception handling for TypeError in validators altered (TypeError now propagates instead of being wrapped), and dataclass/optional field behavior aligned with stdlib dataclasses. All call sites of these changed APIs must be updated to restore test collection and execution.
dependency_changes: Update project dependency specification (e.g., pyproject.toml, setup.py, requirements.txt) to pydantic>=2.14.0,<3

steps.change: Replace the `__root__` field with a standard field (e.g., `root: List[KubeObject]`) and decorate the class with `@root_validator` (from `pydantic.deprecated.class_validators.root_validator`) to implement root model behavior. Also update `update_forward_refs()` calls to `model_rebuild()` on lines 33 and 34.
steps.why: `__root__` is removed in v2; root models now use `@root_validator`. `update_forward_refs` renamed to `model_rebuild`.

steps.change: Change `KubeSecurityContent.parse_obj(data)` to `KubeSecurityContent.model_validate(data)`. Modify the except clause to catch only `(ValidationError, JSONDecodeError)` and remove `TypeError` (since TypeError now propagates directly).
steps.why: `parse_obj` renamed to `model_validate`. TypeError in validators no longer converted to ValidationError.

steps.change: Update `update_forward_refs()` to `model_rebuild()` on line 30. Change config `allow_population_by_field_name = True` to `populate_by_name = True` on line 14. Note that `alias` on fields now returns None when not set (behaviour change).
steps.why: Method renamed, config key renamed, alias behaviour changed.

steps.change: Modify the except clause to catch only `(ValidationError, JSONDecodeError)` and remove `TypeError`.
steps.why: TypeError in validators now propagates directly.

steps.change: If any model instance calls `.dict()`, change to `.model_dump()`. The line 24 appears to be a defaultdict initialization; verify no model method call is present.
If any model instance calls `.dict()`, change to `.model_dump()`. The line 22 appears to be a defaultdict initialization; verify no model method call is present.
Move any parent model config to the `@dataclass` decorator's `config` parameter on lines 7, 39, and 44.
steps.why: Parent config no longer applied to vanilla dataclass fields; must use config param on decorator.

steps.change: Change config `allow_population_by_field_name = True` to `populate_by_name = True` on line 12.
Ensure dataclass fields are passed dicts not tuples (lines 16, 17, 56). Review `argparse.BooleanOptionalAction` usage for Optional/Nullable logic changes (line 27).
steps.why: Dataclass fields no longer accept tuples; Optional/Nullable logic matches dataclasses.

steps.change: Replace custom `__init__` (line 20) with `@root_validator` if this class is a Pydantic model. Adjust Optional field handling per new logic (lines 4, 23).
steps.why: Custom __init__ overrides not called; use @root_validator. Optional/Nullable logic changed.

steps.change: Replace custom `__init__` (line 10) with `@root_validator` if this class is a Pydantic model.
Verify if this exception class is a Pydantic model; if so, replace custom `__init__` (line 4) with `@root_validator`. Otherwise, no change needed.
Change the validator to raise `ValidationError` instead of `TypeError` on line 6, so validation errors are caught by the updated except clauses in scanners.
steps.why: TypeError in validator no longer converted to ValidationError; raise ValidationError for validation failures.

risks: Alias fields in trivy models now return None when not set, which may affect serialization keys.
Extra fields on dataclasses are no longer stored as attributes (extra='allow' behavior changed to 'ignore').
Optional/Nullable field logic now matches stdlib dataclasses, potentially changing required/optional behaviour.
TypeError raised in custom validators will now propagate as TypeError instead of being wrapped in ValidationError; ensure validators raise ValidationError.
Root model implementation via @root_validator may have different validation order than the old __root__ field.

name: migrate
detail: Super migrates each planned file in one pass, in parallel
